title: RSIMed: Scaling Medical Foundation Models beyond Limited Clinical Data via Retrieval-Grounded Self-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.18646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rare diseases are hard to diagnose, and the labeled clinical records needed to train models for them are few, private, and slow to extend, since a specialist must read every case. A model that writes its own training tasks could learn beyond these records, but no program can check a model-written diagnosis, and a wrong answer key corrupts training. To tackle this dilemma between data scarcity and difficulty of data annotations, we introduce RSIMed, Recursive Self-Improvement in Medicine, one of the first self-evolving pipelines in which a task proposer co-evolves in context with a diagnostic solver on real clinical records. Seeded by training admissions, a frozen copy of the solver writes each clinical question from retrieved medical evidence, so its answer rests on a source, and steers topics and difficulty toward what the solver still gets wrong. translated_title: RSIMed：通过基于检索的自我进化，使医学基础模型突破有限临床数据的限制
translated_abstract: 罕见疾病难以诊断，而训练相关模型所需的标注临床记录稀少、私密且扩展缓慢，因为每一份病例都需要专科医生亲自阅读。一个能够自行编写训练任务的模型可以超越这些记录进行学习，但没有任何程序能够校验模型自行编写的诊断，而错误的答案会破坏训练。为了解决数据稀缺与数据标注困难之间的两难困境，我们提出了RSIMed（医学中的递归自我改进），这是首批自进化流水线之一，其中任务提出者与诊断求解器在真实临床记录上进行上下文协同进化。以训练住院记录为种子，求解器的一个冻结副本根据检索到的医学证据编写每个临床问题，因此其答案有据可依，并将主题和难度引导至求解器仍然出错的方向。在基于MIMIC-IV住院记录的罕见疾病诊断任务上，RSIMed-27B的准确率呈现线性（增长……摘要此处截断）
tldr: RSIMed提出了首个医学领域的检索证据驱动的递归自我进化框架，通过任务提出者与诊断求解器在真实临床记录上的协同进化，自动生成有据可依、针对模型弱点的训练任务，从而在标注数据稀缺的罕见病诊断上持续提升模型准确率。
en_tdlr: RSIMed introduces one of the first retrieval-grounded recursive self-improvement pipelines in medicine, where a task proposer co-evolves with a diagnostic solver on real clinical records, generating evidence-grounded training tasks targeted at the solver's weaknesses to scale rare-disease diagnosis beyond limited labeled clinical data.
